name: Silverco Mining Ltd.
summary: Silverco Mining Ltd. acquires, explores, and develops mineral properties in Canada and Mexico. It primarily explores silver, lead, copper, zinc, and gold deposits. The company owns a 100% interest in the 95 mineral concessions covering an area of approximately 11,665 hectares Cusi Mine Complex located in Chihuahua State, Mexico; and La Negra Mine project located in Querétaro State, central Mexico. The company was formerly known as Quetzal Copper Corp. Silverco Mining Ltd. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
